# Volume 5 timeline

## CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN

**[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) walks up the road to [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to visit Dr. and Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), who have recently returned from a three-month trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). While waiting on the porch with sleeping children, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss local gossip, including Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) Miller's troubled marriage.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P12](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0012)_

## CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

**[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) bring [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) up to date on the recent arrival of the new [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister, John Knox Ashdown, and his four untamed children. They discuss the minister's lack of practical sense, his chaotic household, and various humorous mishaps that have occurred since his arrival.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P11](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P23](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025)_

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred, [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) finish their conversation about local church gossip, community members, and Nell's recent travels abroad. Miss Winifred departs, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) alone on the veranda to watch the moon rise over the harbor.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P54](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0054), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P57](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0057), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P71](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0071)_

## CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md)** — The [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children gather in their beloved retreat, [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Kit fries fresh trout over an open fire while Edmund muses poetically about the beauty of the twilight. The group sets their crude outdoor table and prepares to eat just as someone approaches from the manse hill.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P26](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0026), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P30](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0030)_

## CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Bertie Shakespeare](../character/bertie-shakespeare.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Twiss](../character/twiss.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md)** — The Ashdown children sit in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) cemetery talking about gravestones, ghosts, and the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) family. Drawn by the smell of cooked trout, they run down to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and join the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children for supper, quickly becoming fast friends.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045)_

**[Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md)** — Led by the smell of cooked trout, Tobias, [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), and [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) join the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) for a meal. They share stories of their lives and neighbors, quickly becoming fast friends before returning to their respective homes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS

**[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Hezekiah Pollock](../character/hezekiah-pollock.md), Ashdowns, [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Taylor](../character/taylor.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Grimble](../character/grimble.md)** — The Ashdown children find a runaway girl named [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) hiding in an old barn near their home. They feed her and listen as she shares her tragic past, her escape from her abusive guardian, and her unique perspectives on life and religion.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035)_

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), Carrows, [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md)** — Mary discusses her fear of damnation and beatings with [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) and [Grace](../character/grace.md) before being introduced to the [Carrows](../codex/factions.md#carrows) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Afterwards, the girls arrange for Mary to sleep in the parsonage garret room. Later that night, [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) comforts Mary in the garret, where Mary expresses her fears and jealousy before they reconcile and fall asleep.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P93](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0093), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P127](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0127)_

## CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), Bailey, [Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), [Cecilia Ashdown](../character/cecilia-ashdown.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Grimble](../character/grimble.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md)** — [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) attends church with the manse children using borrowed clothes, making a scene by sticking her tongue out at a parishioner. Refusing to attend school, she cleans the manse, spars with [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) over food, and spends time with the local children at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Despite occasional arguments, Mary captivates the children with her stories, ghost tales, and unique tricks.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P9](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Elizabeth Kirk](../character/elizabeth-kirk.md), [Emmeline Drew](../character/emmeline-drew.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md) is tasked with carrying a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) harasses and chases her through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) street with a dried codfish. Miss Winifred rescues the terrified [Tessa](../character/tessa-carrow.md) and returns her home, where Miss Winifred, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss Mary's wild behavior, the local children, and potential wives for the minister.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P19](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0019)_

## CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES

**[Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md)** — Miss Winifred interrogates Mary at the manse and later updates [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) after learning that Mrs. [Grimble](../character/grimble.md) has died. Meanwhile, the children gather at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where Edmund reads myths and imagines the Pied Piper leading them away. [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md) arrives with news of Mrs. Grimble's death, startling Mary, but [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) reassures her and promises to pray that Mary can remain in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039)_

## CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES

**[Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md)** — Miss Winifred urges Mr. Ashdown to address Mary's upbringing, leading Mr. Ashdown to speak warmly with the girl. Driven by Mary's impending return to the asylum, [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) visits Miss Winifred to ask if she will take Mary in. After consulting her husband [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), Miss Winifred agrees to adopt Mary, and the children give Mary farewell gifts.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IX. **[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md)** — Mary and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) converse about faith and the possibility of Mr. Ashdown remarrying, which leaves [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) frightened and tearful. Meanwhile, [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) reads through the night and contemplates his late wife, oblivious to Ida's distress.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P78](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0078), [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P82](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0082), [v5 CHAPTER IX. **[Adella](../character/adella.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Posy](../character/posy.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md)** — While their father is away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden, [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) attempt to clean the house, but accidentally spark a village scandal when they beat carpets in the cemetery, believing it is Monday rather than Sunday.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. ## CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Baxter](../character/baxter.md), [Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), Christians, [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Elder Abraham](../character/elder-abraham.md), [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Mary informs [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) that they caused a scandal in the community by doing household chores on Sunday after getting their days mixed up. [Grace](../character/grace.md) laughs off the mistake once she realizes how the days were miscounted, reassuring [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) that she has a plan to clarify everything to the town.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P10](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XI. ## CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

**[Bertie Shakespeare](../character/bertie-shakespeare.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Cooper](../character/cooper.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Twiss](../character/twiss.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — During a church service, [Grace](../character/grace.md) interrupts the collection to publicly defend her father and clarify the misunderstanding behind their Sunday cleaning. The next day, she and Edmund ride pigs down Main Street, drawing mixed reactions from townspeople and the local doctor's family. Later, Miss Winifred visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to complain about Grace's antics, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends the child's brave intentions.

[Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) joins the conversation to remark on Barbara's past suitors, after which Miss Winifred talks about preparing for her upcoming tea guests and updates [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md).

## CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL

**[John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Martin Crawford](../character/martin-crawford.md), [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md)** — [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) encounters [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) by the hidden spring in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and crafts a birch cup for her to drink from. He walks her home while engaging in warm conversation, and she invites him into her house, where her sister [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) joins them in discussing global affairs.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P12](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P18](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0018), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P24](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0024)_

**[Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Laurence](../character/laurence.md)** — [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) visits the [Ainslie](../character/ainslie.md) home and engages [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) in a lively political discussion about [Germany](../codex/places.md#germany) and the Kaiser while [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) looks for his book. After Ashdown departs, [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) warns [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) that the minister seems interested in courting her and reminds her of a promise she made. Irritated by the suggestion, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) dismisses Harriet's warnings and retires upstairs to her room feeling troubled.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P24](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0024), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P30](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0030), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. ## CHAPTER XIV. MRS. HECTOR TWISS MAKES A CALL

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Twiss](../character/twiss.md)** — [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) becomes engrossed in [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, neglecting his duties and family. Mrs. Hector Twiss visits the manse and proposes adopting [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), but Ashdown firmly rejects her offer. Outraged, Mrs. [Twiss](../character/twiss.md) criticizes his parenting before departing, leaving Ashdown deeply shaken and introspective.

## CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

**[Dinah Wren](../character/dinah-wren.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), [Luella](../character/luella.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Myra Murray](../character/myra-murray.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Russell](../character/russell.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Twiss](../character/twiss.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) visit [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to discuss Myra Murray's funeral and church gossip. They debate the nature of the afterlife and discuss various church members, including Mrs. [Hector](../character/hector.md) Twiss's threat to withhold her subscription, before sending [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where she tells [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) about the potential financial troubles facing her father's parish.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P9](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XV. [Grace](../character/grace.md) despairs over the thought of having to leave the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), but while looking out her bedroom window at night, she hatches a plan to visit [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) and fix the problem herself.

## CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

**[Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), [Coyle](../character/coyle.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — [Grace](../character/grace.md) walks through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), enduring an insult from [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md) on her way to visit [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md). When she arrives at Lionel's residence, he berates and dismisses her request for him to return to church. Furious at his treatment, [Grace](../character/grace.md) marches back into his house to confront him.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P22](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. **[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — Furious at Lionel Fairlie's insults, [Grace](../character/grace.md) marches back into his house and angrily confronts him. Amused and impressed by her spirit, Lionel warms to her, agrees to attend church once a month, and restores his financial contribution to her father's salary before driving her home with gifts.

## CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

**[Coyle](../character/coyle.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md)** — After church, [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) briefly speaks with Mr. Ashdown and [Grace](../character/grace.md). On Monday, [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md) taunts [Grace](../character/grace.md) and Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), prompting [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) to defend them and challenge Dan to a fight. The following evening, despite his initial dread and anxiety, Edmund fiercely fights Dan at school, forces him to take back his insults, and then encounters Mr. Ashdown on his way home.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. **[Coyle](../character/coyle.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Edmund finishes his fight with [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md), forcing Dan to retract his insults. On his way home through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), Edmund encounters Mr. Ashdown, who praises him for defending the honor of women. Later, after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tends to Edmund's bruises, Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss the fight as well as rumors regarding Mr. Ashdown courting [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).

## CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), Fern Hollow, [Grace](../character/grace.md), Hollowmere, [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Twiss](../character/twiss.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Perry](../character/perry.md), Port Marlow, Seven Gulls, [Taylor](../character/taylor.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) joins [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md), and [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to chew spruce gum. [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) feels envious of Mary's fine new clothes and muff, while Mary brings news of local gossip and mentions that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed a rooster for dinner. Horrified that their pet rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md) has been killed, [Grace](../character/grace.md) rushes home, prompting [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) to repentantly give Mary her gum and compliment her muff.

## CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM!

**[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md)** — [Grace](../character/grace.md) is furious and heartbroken after [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) slaughters her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), to serve to the visiting minister, Mr. Perry. During dinner, [Grace](../character/grace.md) openly dislikes Mr. Perry, who eats [Adam](../character/adam.md) and preaches at her. Later in the study, [Grace](../character/grace.md) secretly watches Mr. Perry's coat-tails catch fire from the hearth, getting revenge on him when he scorches his new coat.

## CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Coyle](../character/coyle.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Perry](../character/perry.md)** — After being teased at school about the loss of her rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md) goes toward [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) seeking comfort from Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md). In [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), she meets [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), who listens sympathetically to Grace's grief and offers her a pet canary. [Grace](../character/grace.md) returns home feeling comforted and tells her father and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) how much she loves [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P0](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P3](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XX. ## CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD

**[John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), Carrows, [James A](../character/james-a.md), [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [Cecilia Ashdown](../character/cecilia-ashdown.md), [Emmeline Drew](../character/emmeline-drew.md), [Elizabeth Kirk](../character/elizabeth-kirk.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), [Laurence](../character/laurence.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), [Martin Crawford](../character/martin-crawford.md)** — [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) walks through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) on his way to propose to [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), reflecting on his feelings for her and his reluctance to take a "suitable" second wife. Meanwhile, [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) prepares to hold [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to a past vow to reject him despite their fond mutual regard, leaving [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) anxious about turning him down.

Years later, [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) proposes to [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), but bound by her vow to [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), she hesitates and asks him for time to consider before he departs.

## CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT

**[Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Laurence](../character/laurence.md)** — [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) returns home from a party after seeing [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) and pondering her feelings. Upon arriving, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) reveals that [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) proposed to her and asks [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) to release her from her vow never to abandon her. ## CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Zilla Marsh](../character/zilla-marsh.md)** — In an impulse of charity, [Grace](../character/grace.md) gives her only good shoes and stockings to barefoot [Zilla Marsh](../character/zilla-marsh.md), who quickly leaves to preserve her new possessions. Realizing she will now have to wear her hated striped stockings to church, [Grace](../character/grace.md) stands barefoot in a snowbank to catch a cold so she can legitimately stay home. [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) and Tobias pull [Grace](../character/grace.md) off the ice after a loud struggle that onlookers misinterpret as a fight, though [Grace](../character/grace.md) wakes up healthy the next morning still determined not to wear the stockings.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P12](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. ## CHAPTER XXVI. MISS WINIFRED GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW

**[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) to complain about a scandalous letter by [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) published in the local paper by [Joe Vickers](../character/joe-vickers.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) argues passionately that the town should celebrate the Ashdown family's talents and virtues rather than apologize for them, inspiring Miss Winifred to change her perspective.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVI. MISS WINIFRED GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW P11](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXVI. MISS WINIFRED GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XXVI. MISS WINIFRED GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW P24](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0024)_

## CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT

**[Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [Baxter](../character/baxter.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [God](../character/god.md), Good-Conduct Club, [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), Methodist, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), and Hugh discuss the manse children's disruptive graveyard concert during the [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) prayer meeting and Winifred's conversation with their father. Afterwards, Mr. Ashdown summons his children to his study to confront them about the incident. Remorseful, the children promise to punish themselves through their club, while Mr. Ashdown laments his perceived failings as a father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P1](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P10](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P13](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P22](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0022)_

## CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY

**[Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), Good-Conduct Club, [Elizabeth Kirk](../character/elizabeth-kirk.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md)** — The [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) decides to fast on Sunday as punishment for their graveyard song, which causes [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) to faint during the church service. Doctor [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) and Mrs. Elder Clow help revive her, leading [Grace](../character/grace.md) to explain their self-punishment rule to their distraught father. Realizing how neglected his children are, [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) reflects mournfully on his duties as a father and his unresolved love for [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) before returning to his theological studies.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P0](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P11](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P16](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P21](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0021)_

## CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE

**[Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — While spending a pleasant spring evening at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), the children share their dreams for the future until [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) arrives and startles them with a ghost story about [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md) and the nearby ruined [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) property. After Mary cooks trout for the group, darkness falls and the lingering terror forces [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), and [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) to head home together, carefully avoiding the old garden.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P0](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P14](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0014)_

## CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE

**[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md)** — Terrified by a white figure crawling in the [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden that they mistake for Henry Warren's ghost, [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) flee from [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere). [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) calms the children while [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) goes to investigate with a pitchfork. [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) returns with the news that the 'ghost' was merely old Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md) crawling around in white sheets searching for a lost knitting needle.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P3](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P8](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P9](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P25](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0025)_

## CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE

**[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md)** — Tobias punishes [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) for running away from a ghost by forcing him to sit on a graveyard tombstone until midnight. [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) endures the chilly rain during his midnight vigil and subsequently falls gravely ill with double pneumonia. After a tense battle for his life, [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) recovers with the support of the community and returns to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE P8](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE P22](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE P32](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0032)_

## CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE

**[Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), [Laurence](../character/laurence.md), [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md)** — [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) confronts [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and asks her to release her sister [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) from a vow so they can marry, which [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) willingly grants. Afterwards, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) returns home and informs [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) of her consent, but [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) insists she will not marry Lionel if [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) refuses to come live with them.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P13](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P24](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0024), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P41](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0041)_

## CHAPTER XXXIII. RUPERT IS—NOT—WHIPPED

**[Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md)** — [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) gossip-shares village rumors with [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) about why [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) refused their father's proposal and how [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) threw an eel into Mrs. Carr's buggy. Learning of the incident, Mr. Ashdown intends to whip [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) in his study, but relents at the last second when he sees his late wife's eyes in the boy, leaving both father and son deeply shaken.

## CHAPTER XXXIV. IDA VISITS THE HILL

**[Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md)** — [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) visits [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to ask her to marry her father, offering to be well-behaved so he will be happy. [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) reassures [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) about being a friend rather than an evil stepmother, and sends [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) back with a letter to her father. After [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) leaves, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) tells [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) the news, and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) delivers the note to her father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. IDA VISITS THE HILL P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. IDA VISITS THE HILL P24](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0024), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. IDA VISITS THE HILL P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. IDA VISITS THE HILL P44](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0044)_

## CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME”

**[Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Izzy](../character/izzy.md), [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md), [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Miss Winifred discuss the upcoming marriages of [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) Ashdown and [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), as well as plans for the minister's children while he is away. Meanwhile, the local children gather outdoors on Kit's final night before leaving for Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), where Edmund imagines the Pied Piper calling the boys away to follow him.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P1](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P16](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0016)_
